2026-10-11.text:
Another light one for most of us, with one surprise this morning. Howe Sound is blowing a proper outflow: Pam Rocks read NNE 25 gusting 32 at 8am, which is strong enough for Porteau to work. If you're close and quick, that's the strongest wind of the day, and the tide is dropping until about 12:40pm so the swell should hold. Environment Canada has it fading to 5 to 15 near noon, so don't wait.

For everyone else, Jericho is my pick again from 2pm to 5pm, about 14 to 15 kt W gusting 17, with small waves building to 2 ft later in the afternoon. The launch gets easier after 3pm when the tide is back over 10 ft. Environment Canada is calling NW 15 to 20 late this afternoon, a bit more than the models, so watch the live readings.

Squamish is the wildcard. The models keep it on a northerly outflow until mid afternoon, then a light southerly under 10 kt. They said the same yesterday and the Spit ran 15 to 20 on inflow from 1pm to 4pm. Today's outflow is much stronger, so I wouldn't count on a repeat, but it's full sun again. If Pam Rocks swings south by noon, it may be worth the drive. Bring the big wing!

2026-10-10.text: I hope everyone is tired from yesterday, but if you didn’t get enough... here is what’s on the menu for today. It’s a lighter one. The NW comes back this afternoon and Jericho is my pick from 2pm to 6pm, about 14 to 16 kt W to WNW, with an easier launch after 3pm when the tide is back over 10 ft. Environment Canada is calling NW 15 to 20 from noon, which is more and earlier than the models show, so keep an eye on the live readings around lunch. Squamish has a gusty northerly outflow of 12 to 15 kt gusting 23, and it only gets strong after dark. Bring the big wing!

2026-10-09.text: The NW system is here and today is the day. I believe Steveston is the pick, with 22 to 24 kt WNW gusting 30 from 8am to 5pm and good swell of 3 to 4 ft, plus a possible epic window before 10am while the tide is still falling against the wind. Jericho will be on all day too, but it looks very strong midday, with 30 kt plus and gusts near 40 from 10am to 3pm, swell up to 6 ft, and a long walk at low tide from about 9am to 2pm, so early morning or after 3pm is the easier call there. Crescent Beach has a short window until about 9am with 22 to 25 kt before the wind turns too far NW. Squamish looks lighter at around 17 kt in the afternoon, and I would skip the rest. Environment Canada has a strong wind warning with NW 20 to 30 this morning, easing to 15 to 20 by evening. Salmon are running in the Fraser, so watch your foil at Steveston. Have fun out there!

2026-10-08.text: Today I believe the only ridable spot is Squamish, 1pm to 5pm, with 18 to 19 kt SSW gusting 23. Not much else until tomorrow, which looks like a fun, strong NW system coming in. Stay tuned!

2026-10-07.text: Jericho may see some low teens wind in the afternoon for those in big gear and kite foiling, and I believe Squamish will see some thermal winds late in the afternoon, around the high teens and maybe gusting over 20. Not much more in the area, so keep an eye on the sensors.

2026-10-06.text: Marine clouds will settle in the area, which could make Squamish work better. I think Squamish will see high teens and low twenties again, and possibly more if the sun hits for longer hours there. I don't see much else ridable in the area, so head over to Squamish and enjoy the sun!

2026-10-05.text: Not much ridable wind in the area today other than Squamish, which will develop a thermal in the afternoon. I would say high teens gusting to the low twenties, and maybe more with the help of the pressure gradient today, depending on cloud cover in the afternoon. Looks clear, and that should bring some wind.

2026-10-04.text: If you're looking for more than 18 knots, today is the day for golfing. I think the only viable forecast, at sub 18 knots, will be Squamish, and it will depend on cloud cover. The inflow shows as coming, however I believe it will be in the mid teens and possibly gusting sub 20 knots in the late afternoon. I don't see ridable wind anywhere else in the area.

2026-10-03.text: Looks like the NW winds are back and will bring some wind to Jericho in the high teens, maybe gusting 20. If you want a sure bet, Squamish will work. It will most likely bring low 20s or high teens in the afternoon, a bit more if the sky remains clear and the temperature heats up. The pressure gradient is inverted so that will slow things down, but sunny in Squamish may win!

2026-10-01.text: Today nothing looks rideable. The best is Porteau from 15:00 to 16:00, 6 to 7.5 kt from the north, at 12% to 19%. Looks like a rest day!

2026-09-30.text: The only place that may see some wind today is Squamish. The pressure gradient shows an inversion, however the temperature thermal difference may bring wind if the cloud cover doesn't get in the way. I'd guess it'll be on the lighter side of things, mid teens to high teens, and if it works, it would be later in the afternoon.
